pieces.name: Steiner Kampfgruppe
pieces.notes: Scan is low quality. Line under name reads '101.Jager Division I./228.JG.RGT' (tile subtitle is 'Heroic Platoon'). Three red squares down the right of the portrait. Four slots with a bow-and-arrow shield badge, black band across all four. Unit pictures names read from tiny captions (Fire Group x2, Steiner, Recon Group, MG 32), moderately certain.
